hint_json.simple: 在评价一件衣服的面料触感和颜色实用性。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 feel + 形容词表达手感。后半句用 ____ 表达对颜色耐脏程度的预测。
hint_json.complete: The fabric of this trench coat _____ quite nice, but the light colour _____ stay clean for long.

fill-053-070.learning_goal: Use sensory verbs and predictive 'won't' to evaluate a product's strengths and weaknesses.
fill-053-070.learning_rationale: Shopping evaluations combine sensory impressions ('feels/looks/smells + adj') with practical predictions.

fill-053-071.prompt_zh: 去机场的地铁最早一班是五点半，你赶七点的飞机应该来得及。
fill-053-071.reference_answer: The first subway to the airport is at five thirty — you should be able to make your seven o'clock flight.
grammar_point: Should be able to for reasonable expectation

hint_json.simple: 在告诉别人最早一班地铁的时间，并评估能否赶上飞机。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 be + at + 时间说班次时间。后半句用 ____ 表达合理的可能性。
hint_json.complete: The first subway to the airport is at ____ — you should be able to _____ your seven o'clock flight.

fill-053-071.learning_goal: Give transit schedule information and assess whether a connection is feasible.
fill-053-071.learning_rationale: 'Should be able to' is the standard expression for reasonable travel feasibility assessments.

fill-053-072.prompt_zh: 你刚做完手术，半年内最好不要搬重东西。
fill-053-072.reference_answer: You just had surgery — you'd better not lift anything heavy for six months.
grammar_point: Had better not for strong negative advice

hint_json.simple: 在给术后恢复的建议——不能做什么、持续多久。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用过去时交代背景。后半句用 ____ + 动词原形给强硬的禁忌建议。
hint_json.complete: You just had surgery — you'd better not _____ anything heavy for _____.

fill-053-072.learning_goal: Give a strong post-procedure restriction using 'had better not' with a time boundary.
fill-053-072.learning_rationale: 'Had better not' is stronger and more personal than 'shouldn't', appropriate for medical aftercare.

fill-053-073.prompt_zh: 这个充电宝在飞机上不能用，过安检的时候要单独拿出来。
fill-053-073.reference_answer: This power bank can't be used on the plane — you need to take it out separately at security.
grammar_point: Can't be + past participle for prohibition

hint_json.simple: 在说一个物品在飞机上禁止使用、安检时的处理方式。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 can't be + 过去分词表达禁令。后半句用 ____ + 动词原形说安检时的要求。
hint_json.complete: This power bank can't be _____ on the plane — you need to take it _____ at security.

fill-053-073.learning_goal: State a flight-related prohibition and describe the security procedure.
fill-053-073.learning_rationale: Travel regulations are naturally expressed with 'can't be + PP' for rules and 'need to' for procedures.

fill-053-074.prompt_zh: 我在等一个很重要的快递，你能帮我留意一下门铃吗？
fill-053-074.reference_answer: I'm waiting for a very important delivery — could you keep an ear out for the doorbell?

hint_json.simple: 在等快递，请别人帮忙留意门铃。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 be + V-ing 表达正在等。后半句用 ____ 做礼貌请求。
hint_json.complete: I'm waiting for a _____ delivery — could you keep an _____ out for the doorbell?

fill-053-074.learning_goal: Use present continuous to describe an ongoing situation and make a household request.
fill-053-074.learning_rationale: 'Keep an ear out for' is a natural phrasal alternative to 'listen for', common in household English.

fill-053-075.prompt_zh: 如果项目下周五之前不能交付，客户有权要求赔偿。
fill-053-075.reference_answer: If the project cannot be delivered by next Friday, the client is entitled to claim compensation.
grammar_point: Be entitled to for legal right

hint_json.simple: 在说一个合同条款——逾期交付的后果。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 if + 被动表达条件。后半句用 be entitled to 表达对方的法定权利。
hint_json.complete: If the project cannot be _____ by next Friday, the client is _____ to claim compensation.

fill-053-075.learning_goal: Use a conditional with passive voice and 'be entitled to' to express a contractual obligation.
fill-053-075.learning_rationale: 'Be entitled to' is the standard English phrasing for legal and contractual rights — more precise than 'can' or 'may'.

fill-053-076.prompt_zh: 虽然这部电影的评分不高，但我觉得剧情还是挺有意思的，至少不无聊。
fill-053-076.reference_answer: Although this film's rating isn't high, I thought the plot was quite interesting — at least it wasn't boring.
grammar_point: Past tense for opinion about experience

hint_json.simple: 在表达和评分不一致的个人看法——虽然分低，但内容不错。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 although 引导让步。后半句用过去时 I thought 表达主观感受，然后用 ____ 缓和评价。
hint_json.complete: _____ this film's rating isn't high, I thought the plot was quite interesting — at _____ it wasn't boring.

fill-053-076.learning_goal: Express a personal opinion that goes against a general consensus using concessive structures and hedging.
fill-053-076.learning_rationale: Going against the consensus requires both concessive grammar and social hedging — a sophisticated communication skill.

fill-053-077.prompt_zh: 如果你对这份报价有任何疑问，请随时联系我们，我们会尽快回复。
fill-053-077.reference_answer: If you have any questions about this quotation, please do not hesitate to contact us — we will respond as soon as possible.

hint_json.simple: 在礼貌地邀请对方有疑问就联系，并承诺快速回复。
hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 if 从句做条件。后半句用 ____ 做非常客气的邀请。
hint_json.complete: If you have any questions about this _____, please do not _____ to contact us — we will respond as soon as possible.

fill-053-077.learning_goal: Use 'please do not hesitate to' to formally invite follow-up communication.
fill-053-077.learning_rationale: 'Please do not hesitate to' is a fixed formal expression that signals genuine openness to questions.

fill-053-078.prompt_zh: 这座山看着不高，但爬到山顶至少要两个小时。
fill-053-078.reference_answer: This mountain doesn't look tall, but it takes at least two hours to reach the top.

fill-053-078.learning_goal: Use 'doesn't look' to contrast appearance with fact and 'it takes + duration' for time needed.
fill-053-078.learning_rationale: Appearance-vs-reality contrasts are a common conversational move in travel and outdoor contexts.

fill-053-079.prompt_zh: 别忘了明天一早把垃圾桶推出去，这周收垃圾提前了一天。
fill-053-079.reference_answer: Don't forget to put the bin out first thing tomorrow — rubbish collection has been moved a day earlier this week.

hint_json.intermediate: 前半句用 ____ 提醒别忘了做某事。后半句用现在完成时被动表达「已经调整了」的时间。

fill-053-079.learning_goal: Use 'don't forget to' for reminders and present perfect passive for a changed schedule.
fill-053-079.learning_rationale: Household reminders blend imperatives with present perfect passive for service-change notifications.

fill-053-080.prompt_zh: 关于年假申请，人事部说需要提前两周提交，紧急情况可以走特批。
fill-053-080.reference_answer: Regarding annual leave applications, HR says they need to be submitted two weeks in advance — exceptions can be approved for emergencies.
grammar_point: Can be + past participle for exception

hint_json.intermediate: 用 Regarding 开头引入话题。正常流程用 need to be + 过去分词。例外情况用 can be + 过去分词。

fill-053-080.learning_goal: Use formal topic introduction and passive constructions to explain a policy with exception handling.
fill-053-080.learning_rationale: Policy explanations in formal English chain 'Regarding', passive obligation, and passive exception — a workplace writing staple.
